    Controls
      
    
        
    WASD
    Move (double-tap W or hold Ctrl to sprint)
    
        
    Space
    Jump. Press again right as you land to bunny hop
    
        
    Hold left
    Break blocks or hit animals
    
        
    Right
    Place, eat, or feed animals
    
        
    V
    Switch camera: 1st, 3rd and 2nd person
    
        
    E Q
    Inventory and crafting, drop an item
    
        
    T / M
    Chat, commands, game menu
    
      
    
      
    
        
    Left thumb
    Move. Push all the way to sprint
    
        
    Right thumb
    Look. Tap to place, hold to break
    
        
    JUMP
    Tap again right as you land to bunny hop
